headline: Osia Hyper Retail Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process; Form G published
sum: Osia Hyper Retail Limited, a retail chain operator, has entered Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Form G-the statutory notice of CIRP initiation-was published on 26 June 2026, with formal disclosure to NSE on 24 July 2026.
detail: Osia Hyper Retail Limited, engaged in organised retail operations, is subject to CIRP under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The corporate debtor's Form G (statutory publication intimating commencement of CIRP) was published on 26 June 2026. The NSE disclosure (filed 24 July 2026) is a post-facto notification to the stock exchange, confirming the newspaper publication milestone. The identity of the financial creditor who initiated the petition, the admitted claim value, and the appointed Insolvency Professional are not disclosed in the current filing.
